data_fields.name: burst_count
data_fields.donor_constant: min(spriteData.width, 7) for a land crash; 10 per car on car-on-car; 5 splashes plus 10 chips on water

data_fields.name: launch_up_speed
data_fields.donor_constant: 0x10000 + random 0-0xFFFF times 4 (about 1 to 5 units per tick)

data_fields.name: launch_side_speed
data_fields.donor_constant: signed 16-bit random times 4 (about -2 to +2 units per tick)

best_idea: A hit or break spawns a capped burst of short-lived chips with random launch vectors, gravity, air drag, one bounce off the ground and a splash on water, all as client-side sprites that never enter fight state.
decision_why: The burst shape is useful for impact debris, but the donor keeps chips as saved game entities with a scenario RNG and has no global cap; Frankendom needs client-only chips fed by the server hit event, a client RNG and a global live-chip cap for many-on-one fights.
acceptance: On a killing blow that breaks armour, a short spray of chips leaves the strike point, arcs, bounces once off the sand and fades after its lifetime; a server test asserts the burst count comes from the hit event and no chip appears in the fight state snapshot.
